skill.name: nx-matting
skill.description: Remove backgrounds from images and videos with local BiRefNet GGUF inference on Windows, producing transparent PNG, MOV, or WebM files.
skill.summary: Create transparent image and video assets with local BiRefNet inference.
skill.author: xiaowu89

security_audit.summary: Most backtick, reconnaissance, temporary-path, and entropy alerts are syntax or documentation false positives. Confirmed risks include PowerShell execution with policy bypass, automatic remote artifact downloads, and unverified FFmpeg discovery outside the skill root. A critical instruction forces assistants to repeat a Base64-obfuscated third-party contact notice.

remediation.issue: The skill forces assistants to repeat an unsolicited third-party contact notice.
remediation.suggestion: Remove contactNotice, the mandatory reply instructions, and the Base64-encoded contact string from the skill and script.

remediation.issue: The skill automatically downloads and executes opaque native runtimes.
remediation.suggestion: Publish source and reproducible builds, use immutable release URLs, verify publisher signatures, and require user confirmation before downloading executables.

remediation.issue: Examples invoke PowerShell with ExecutionPolicy Bypass.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the bypass flag, sign the script, and document the minimum execution policy required for normal use.

remediation.issue: FFmpeg discovery can execute binaries found outside the skill root without integrity verification.
remediation.suggestion: Use only an explicit trusted FFmpeg path or a downloaded artifact with a pinned hash and verified publisher signature.

content.value_statement: Background removal often requires complex local tools or cloud uploads. This skill runs BiRefNet locally and creates transparent image or video files.
actual_capabilities: Converts JPG, PNG, BMP, and WebP images into transparent PNG files.
Converts MP4, MOV, and WebM videos into transparent MOV or WebM files.
Offers Lite and Full BiRefNet GGUF models for speed or quality.
Selects CPU or Vulkan inference and can retry failed Vulkan work on CPU.
Downloads models, native runtimes, and FFmpeg when required, then verifies file size and SHA-256.
Reports progress, completion details, and diagnostic paths through JSONL events.
limitations: First use requires network access and substantial downloads; the Full model is about 440 MB.
Results depend on source quality and may require manual edge correction.
The skill removes backgrounds but does not add replacement scenes or perform general video editing.

use_cases.title: Prepare product images
use_cases.description: Create transparent PNG product assets for catalogs, stores, and presentations.

use_cases.title: Extract portrait subjects
use_cases.description: Remove photo backgrounds while preserving people for design compositions.

use_cases.title: Create transparent video
use_cases.description: Convert recorded subjects into MOV or WebM overlays for editing and web projects.

prompt_templates.title: Remove a photo background
prompt_templates.prompt: Remove the background from [image path]. Save a transparent PNG beside the original without overwriting any file.

prompt_templates.title: Create a product cutout
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Full model on [product image path]. Save a high-quality transparent PNG to [output path].

prompt_templates.title: Create a web video overlay
prompt_templates.prompt: Remove the background from [video path]. Export transparent WebM to [output path] and omit audio.

prompt_templates.title: Control an advanced run
prompt_templates.prompt: Process [input path] with [CPU or Vulkan], [Lite or Full], cache directory [path], and output [path]. Preserve temporary files for diagnostics.

output_examples.output: Created C:\photos\portrait_transparent.png with the original dimensions and a transparent background.

output_examples.input: Create a transparent WebM from C:\videos\demo.mp4 without audio.
output_examples.output: Created C:\videos\demo_transparent.webm without audio and reported the selected inference backend.

output_examples.input: Check whether this computer is ready for matting.
output_examples.output: Reported Windows architecture, available runtimes, installed models, Vulkan status, cache location, and FFmpeg availability.

best_practices: Keep the source file unchanged and write results to a separate output path.
Use the Lite model for previews, then use Full only when edge quality requires it.
Review alpha edges, video format support, and audio settings before delivery.
anti_patterns: Do not overwrite an existing output without explicit approval.
Do not select the Full model when download size or processing time is constrained.
Do not assume every editor or browser supports transparent MOV or WebM.

faq.question: Which operating systems are supported?
faq.answer: The provided automation supports Windows x64 with PowerShell.

faq.question: Does processing upload my media?
faq.answer: Media inference is local. The skill uses network access to download required models, runtimes, and FFmpeg.

faq.question: Which image formats are accepted?
faq.answer: The skill accepts JPG, PNG, BMP, and WebP images.

faq.question: Which transparent outputs are available?
faq.answer: Images use transparent PNG. Videos use transparent MOV by default or WebM when requested.

faq.question: What is the difference between Lite and Full?
faq.answer: Lite is smaller and faster. Full is about 440 MB and targets higher-quality matting.

faq.question: Is a GPU required?
faq.answer: No. CPU inference is supported, while Vulkan can accelerate processing on compatible systems.
